name: Motisons Jewellers Ltd
about: Established in October 1997, Motisons Jewellers Ltd sells gold, diamond and kundan jewellery as well as other jewellery products. The company sells pearls, silver, platinum and other metals.[1]
keyPoints:
Product Range[1] The company offers a wide range of products including traditional, modern, and combination designs in various jewellery lines with over 3,00,000 designs.
 It deals in diamond, polki, gold, temple, italian jewellery.[2]
The company also offers jewellery crafted from earth, silver, platinum, precious and semi-precious stones and other metals, gold and silver coins, utensils, and various artifacts.[3]

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 68.7% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 13.4% over last 3 years.
